checks: Complete native Accounts migrations apply twice; single/batch joins receive distinct epochs; unread and unchanged-role updates preserve them
Lifecycle v1 upgrades to v2 and repeats safely; pre-epoch sessions are permanently revoked
Native Accounts removal/re-add entirely between authorization calls and a lifecycle restart permanently rejects the old signed runtime
Role downgrade/restore between checks invalidates the browser session and runtime; a fresh pairing is required
Authority outage/missing epoch fails closed without destroying a valid session; other members remain unchanged
scope: Actual native Accounts SQL/migrations plus strict lifecycle service in disposable CockroachDB; RPC authentication and active Employee are explicit fixtures, not full Accounts pod or live deployment acceptance
